definitions.explanation: A strong desire or determination to do something.

examples.japanese: {学|まな}ぶ{意欲|いよく}がある。
examples.english: To have the motivation to learn.

examples.japanese: {意欲|いよく}が{湧|わ}いてきた。
{意欲|いよく}{的|てき}に{取|と}り{組|く}む。

notes:
{意欲|いよく} describes a strong inner drive or desire to accomplish something. More formal than やる{気|き}.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {意欲|いよく}がある: to have motivation
- {意欲|いよく}が{高|たか}い/{低|ひく}い: highly/poorly motivated
- {意欲|いよく}を{持|も}つ: to have enthusiasm
- {意欲|いよく}が{湧|わ}く: motivation wells up
- {意欲|いよく}{的|てき}に: enthusiastically, proactively
- {学習|がくしゅう}{意欲|いよく}: desire to learn
- {労働|ろうどう}{意欲|いよく}: will to work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やる{気|き}: motivation (casual, everyday)
- {熱意|ねつい}: passion, enthusiasm (focuses on intensity)
- {動機|どうき}: motive (reason behind an action)
- {向上心|こうじょうしん}: ambition to improve oneself

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Common in educational, workplace, and self-improvement contexts.
